parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: The calling vendor (G32). Ownership of the addressed resource is checked against it.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only shipments with `shippedAt` strictly after this instant.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Only shipments bound for this node.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous page. When present, the other filters are ignored.
